displacement_level_selection_rule.interpretation: No H_3-invariant displacement-displacement coupling exists. A mass-like algebraic mixing of phonon and phason amplitudes is forbidden by icosahedral symmetry.

strain_level_selection_rule.coupling_form: C^{mix}_ijkl epsilon_ij w_kl, with epsilon_ij = ∂_i u_parallel^j (in T_1 (x) T_1) and w_kl = ∂_k u_perp^l (in T_1 (x) T_2)
strain_level_selection_rule.physical_identification: This is the standard Socolar-Lubensky-Steinhardt / Lubensky-Ramaswamy-Toner K_3 coupling of icosahedral quasicrystal elasticity, identical to the C^{mix}_ijkl term of App ULA Sec ULA.4.
strain_level_selection_rule.interpretation: Exactly one H_3-invariant strain-strain coupling exists. A phason source drives the phonon equation through this K_3 term; the induced disturbance propagates at phonon speed; subluminal only if v_phonon <= c (Tier 3 premise; fails under P3b, App ORQ O.48(b)).

self_coupling_consistency_checks.interpretation: Self-products T_1 (x) T_1 = A + T_1 + H and T_2 (x) T_2 = A + T_2 + H each contain A with multiplicity 1 — phonon-phonon and phason-phason self-couplings are allowed at linear order.

no_signalling_closure.tier: Conditional (Tier 1 selection rule; Tier 3 subluminality premise) - not a Tier 2 closure
no_signalling_closure.step_2_tier: Tier 2 propagation bound within the declared linear model (the K_3-induced disturbance travels no faster than v_phonon) + Tier 3 premise v_phonon <= c (Lorentz-invariant long-wavelength phonon sector), not derived here; it fails under P3b, where v_phonon ~ c_P = phi^9 c > c (App SNE §SNE.4 Step 2; App ORQ O.48(b))
no_signalling_closure.load_bearing_step: Step 2's Tier 3 premise v_phonon <= c. Step 1 establishes the selection-rule structure of the coupling and identifies the K_3 strain-strain term as the unique channel through which a phason source can drive E_||; Step 2 bounds the propagation speed of that channel by v_phonon, and the readout is subluminal only if v_phonon <= c. Under P3b the channel would be superluminal inside the model; this tension is open (App ORQ O.48(b)).
